architectureDecisions: AD1: Select LOCAL_PREVIEW_V1/NODE_HTTP_V1: Linux x64, installed Node 24, self-contained tracked Node-standard-library JS entrypoints, explicit argv/env/seed/health, loopback only. Three synthetic separate repositories passed. No inferred install/build, downloaded runtime or Docker dependency; reject unsupported profiles before effects.

AD2: Preserve optional caller-owned slice.preview in validateDeliverSlice. runQaOnFreshCheckout passes it to runSliceQa after exact acceptedSha checkout; start before independent checks, retain through QA, dispose before workspace finally. Return setup receipt separately; no-preview shape/behavior remains compatible.

AD3: Export startLocalPreview; implement local-preview.js and local-preview-supervisor.js. IPC lease supervisor creates shell:false Node services in individual process groups, handles errors/close/parent disconnect, waits for cleanup and removes only generated data. Never kill-by-port or adopt persisted PIDs.

AD4: Independently verify clean Git commit/tree, canonical profile/config/seed/entrypoint digests and actual runtime binary/version before start, after readiness, observe/reset and after QA. Candidate HTTP responses corroborate run nonce/role only; they cannot supply authoritative Git/runtime/evaluator identity.

AD5: Opt-in Node protocol reports an owned LISTENING endpoint via IPC after OS allocation and answers protected HTTP health with status 200 plus run token/serviceId. Probe all declared services with bounded response/time limits and no redirects. Unsupported apps are reported rather than patched implicitly.

AD6: Seed generated data outside checkout. reset disposes the old generation, revalidates source/seed identities and returns a new handle/receipt/token; stale handles fail. Mutation followed by reset must reproduce seed-only data and clean Git state.

AD7: Use literal minimal service/supervisor env, no process.env spread or NODE_OPTIONS; reject credential-bearing profile values/internal overrides. BB-130 PLANNED_CONTRACT supplies explicit verifier env overlay with NODE_TEST_CONTEXT stripped. QA receives only a protected PREVIEW_RECEIPT_PATH; receipt omits raw env/token.

AD8: Use OBSERVED_READY/FAILED/UNRESOLVED/DISPOSED and typed causes; retain first specific cause, clean partial starts, report CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE on uncertain shutdown. Missing runtime/unsupported profile/timeout/interrupt do not grant readiness or QA acceptance.

AD9: Defer Dev Container CLI/Testcontainers. Pinned implementation/tests were inspected, not executed. The historical probe lacked Docker; current replay observed Docker available. No container setup comparison was executed, so container setup time remains unknown. Controller SIGKILL cleanup requires a surviving supervisor. Host loss, supervisor death and escaped daemons are excluded; no speedup, broad compatibility or value claim.

AD10: The explicit service wire protocol is localPreviewContract.wireProtocol. Node fork uses operator runtime execPath; strict IPC LISTENING identifies the OS-assigned loopback port and health echoes the protected token/bindings. Seed copy is outside checkout. No shell/runtime wrapper or project-specific guessed health schema is introduced.
implementationSlices: S1 — After BB-130 DONE and fresh exact READY, add strict API/profile/receipt validation, canonical digests and platform/runtime gates in local-preview.js; preserve existing exports and add startLocalPreview. Public startLocalPreview({workspaceRoot,candidate:{id,version,tree},profile,evaluator:{id,digest,criterionIds},signal}) returns typed status/reason/receipt/optional live handle. NODE_HTTP_V1 only: operator-pinned absolute Node24/Linuxx64; services unique ids/tracked JS entries/literal argv/env, protected configInputs and seed regular-file hashes. Require clean HEAD/tree and all pins before effects; reject symlink/traversal/unsupported shapes. Runtime probes and config/seed/service bytes rechecked before observe/reset and after QA. Receipt binds candidate/tree/profile/config/input/runtime/evaluator/services/dataset and has image:null for Node processes. The seed format is JSON array/object <=1MiB; service-specific owned data directory receives seed.json with exact protected bytes. No generic database seeding inference.

S2 — Implement IPC supervisor, all-service health, bounded streams/HTTP/lifecycle, typed failures, owned reset/dispose and disconnect cleanup. Adapt embedded prototype into focused fixtures with strict validation/bounds and crash data cleanup. Use child_process.fork(entry,args,{execPath:runtime.path,cwd,env:minimalEnv,detached:true,stdio:[ignore,pipe,pipe,ipc]}). Verify LISTENING IPC sender, serviceId/runToken/127.0.0.1/port and all-service HTTP health exact candidateVersion/tree/config/seed. Startup default30s/max120s, response16KiB, output64KiB, shutdown5s/max30s. Process creation alone never OBSERVED_READY. Live lease supervisor reaps only groups it spawned, TERM then KILL, including leader-exited groups; ambiguous cleanup UNRESOLVED/CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE. reset disposes old generation and seeds new external owned data; old handle stale, dispose idempotent. No persisted PID adoption/kill-by-port, inherited env, wrappers or Docker. Keep first cause and bounded redacted diagnostics. Inject reserved PREVIEW_CANDIDATE_SHA/TREE, PREVIEW_CONFIG_DIGEST/SEED_DIGEST as checked public identity inputs so the service can answer required health fields. Validate inherited env is absent and all internal overrides rejected. Node DATA_DIR is each service own generation directory; reset copies protected seed.json only after reaping prior groups. The sole new local-preview.js is both public API and private lease supervisor: fork fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) with literal --preview-supervisor; enter child mode only when executed directly with that exact flag. Parent sends one validated START packet; supervisor owns service forks/groups and replies over its own ChildProcess IPC. Schema-check IPC <=64KiB, max32 services; reject unknown messages, duplicate LISTENING, wrong sender and stale token. RESET is serialized, awaits old groups/data disposal, then creates a new generation and returns a new handle; old handle cannot observe/reset. DISPOSE is serialized/idempotent. Parent disconnect aborts startup and triggers the same owned teardown; response correlates owner/generation/request id. No additional undeclared supervisor source file or persisted PID adoption.

S3 — Normalize optional slice.preview; compose it only in existing fresh QA checkout; supply protected receipt through BB-130 env overlay. Keep independent checks authoritative and no-preview behavior compatible; dispose preview before workspace. Add opt-in composition cases to deliver-slice.test.js itself: fake Backend yields exact candidate; protected preview receipt reaches QA command env; readiness never grants ACCEPTED when QA fails; preview dispose occurs before QA workspace disposal on success, verifier failure, thrown verifier and interruption. Test no-preview path without invoking preview. Existing generic tests alone do not cover these new assertions. Inner composition retains public runSliceQa as the bound subject for N11/N12, while outer runDeliverSlice tests verify option forwarding and fresh-worktree teardown. Do not replace the two bound inner subject tests with only outer generic regression.

S4 — local-preview.test.js and deliver-slice.test.js: implement all exact negativeCaseBindings plus three fixed Node/loopback positive profiles using localPreviewContract.api and wireProtocol. Each lifecycle test invokes prepare/reset/dispose through actual owner handle; assert exact receipt bindings/seed generation and foreign resource preservation. Integration uses existing fresh QA checkout and nested finally, no new acceptance authority. Update declared Living docs. This DRAFT already contains final API/schema/file scope, hash-bound executable prototype and labelled results; independent readiness judges this research output, while focused/regression/docs runtime logs are future Worker outputs after READY and dependencies DONE.

localPreviewContract.authority: Caller-declared profile and evaluator are protected inputs supplied separately from the candidate. Receipt is setup evidence and cannot publish quality acceptance.
localPreviewContract.api: startLocalPreview({workspaceRoot,candidate:{id,version,tree},profile,evaluator:{id,digest,criterionIds},signal}) -> {status,reason,receipt,handle?}; OBSERVED_READY has handle {observe(),reset(),dispose()}. Invalid declarations return a typed FAILED receipt before effects. reset returns a new generation/handle and permanently disposes the old handle. dispose is idempotent.

profile.runtime: Operator-selected absolute Node executable with expected version and SHA256. Recheck actual binary/version at observe/reset. Initial support: Node 24/Linux x64.
profile.commands: services:[{id,entry,args,env,port,healthPath}]; unique ids, literal string args, tracked relative JS entrypoints, shell:false. No installers, wrappers, hooks or external-service adoption.
profile.configuration: configInputs:[{path,sha256}],seed:{path,sha256}; tracked regular files, no symlink escape/traversal. Strict shape/limit checks before effects. Canonical sorted JSON for objects, raw SHA256 for files. Seed must be UTF-8 JSON array/object for this finite profile; parse/schema/size failure INVALID_PROFILE before effects, max seed1MiB. Config regular-file digest set remains unchanged through run.
profile.ports: Fixed 127.0.0.1; default port 0 is OS-assigned, nonzero conflict never cleared. No external URLs/redirects. Size/schema-check owned IPC messages and identify child sender.
profile.environment: Literal minimal env plus reserved PREVIEW_RUN_TOKEN/SERVICE_ID/DATA_DIR/PORT; reject internal overrides and credential-bearing keys; remove NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_TEST_CONTEXT. QA gets protected PREVIEW_RECEIPT_PATH through BB-130 explicit overlay. Receipt stores keys/digest, no raw values/token. Reserve and inject PREVIEW_CANDIDATE_SHA, PREVIEW_CANDIDATE_TREE, PREVIEW_CONFIG_DIGEST and PREVIEW_SEED_DIGEST from independently checked pins, so entrypoint can echo expected health bindings. Caller overrides of these keys reject.
profile.budgets: Positive bounded integers: startup default 30000/max120000 ms; probe default1000 within remaining deadline; response max16384 bytes; output default65536 per stream; shutdown default5000/max30000 ms. Bound runtime probes too.

receipt.binding: SHA256 canonical receipt excluding receiptId. Observed health is timestamped, not perpetual. Consumers call live handle.observe and match protected identities/generation; disposed receipts are stale. No raw env/token publication.
receipt.serviceVersions: Process service uses actual Node version plus entry/config digests; image:null is NOT_APPLICABLE. Do not invent container identity or missing measurements.

outcomes.OBSERVED_READY: Every declared service is healthy and all independent bindings match; no QA acceptance is implied.
outcomes.DISPOSED: Only after supervisor has reaped owned groups and removed owned data; retain immutable diagnostics outside the candidate checkout.

localPreviewContract.cleanup: Only live ChildProcess groups created by the supervisor; never persisted PIDs. On error/disconnect TERM then bounded KILL, including groups whose leader exited; await close/signalCode/spawn-error handling and verify owner before removing generated data. Uncertain cleanup is UNRESOLVED. No detached daemon escape or simultaneous supervisor/controller/host-loss guarantee.
localPreviewContract.composition: Normalize/freeze optional slice.preview. Existing commandDeliver manifest forwards it. Fresh QA checkout binds acceptedSha/tree; start preview, write immutable sanitized receipt outside checkout, give QA explicit PREVIEW_RECEIPT_PATH, run existing verifications. Failed setup returns passed:false and no fabricated QA PASS. Nested finally disposes preview before workspace. Attach receipt only when opted in; no new flags/scheduler/acceptance authority.
localPreviewContract.authorityAndLifecycle: The receipt contains candidate/tree/profile/config/input/runtime/evaluator/service/seed bindings, not Product QA verdicts or deployment/runtime authority. snapshot/environment/release identity comes independently from Product QA. reset disposes old generation then starts a new generation with original protected seed; it does not preserve a live DB. A caller requiring migration/restart persistence must implement and own that distinct fixture lifecycle. Supervisor process group membership is live owner state, never reconstructed from a persisted PID.
localPreviewContract.platformSupport: NODE_HTTP_V1 is the sole initial profile on Linux x64 with operator-pinned Node24. No Docker binary, devcontainer hook or installer is invoked. Reject container descriptors as unsupported before effects. Runtime/profile digest binds actual executable bytes and version; arbitrary service code is trusted local execution within declared fixture, not sandboxed.
localPreviewContract.wireProtocol: Service launch uses child_process.fork(entry,args,{execPath:runtime.path,cwd:workspaceRoot,env:minimalEnv,detached:true,stdio:[ignore,pipe,pipe,ipc]}); runtime path is execPath option, entry is modulePath. Service sends {type:LISTENING,serviceId,runToken,host:127.0.0.1,port:integer}; receiver validates exact sender child, token and declared port. HTTP health returns {serviceId,runToken,candidateVersion,candidateTree,configDigest,seedDigest}; require exact values/no redirects. Supervisor uses a separate fork with live IPC lease. Owned data lives in mkdtemp outside checkout; copy seed before service spawn. Lifecycle cleanup awaits group termination and deletes owned data; receipts survive externally. Service entry must implement this documented protocol; no wrapper inference. Service receives those four protected identity environment keys plus PREVIEW_RUN_TOKEN/SERVICE_ID/PORT/DATA_DIR. Each service owns <runRoot>/data/<serviceId>; copy the protected seed regular-file bytes there as seed.json before fork. Entrypoint reads that declared file, never an inferred DB path. Profile/receipt pins initial seed bytes; live mutations are checked by caller assertions, reset re-copies original seed to a new generation. Lease supervisor bootstrap and serialized parent/child protocol are specified in S2; all service groups belong to that live owner, not the API controller process.
